tickets.title: Open new client account
tickets.text: Open the approved new joint taxable account using the existing custodian workflow. Confirm account type as joint taxable, ownership for Lila Copperwisp and Rowan Thistlefable, funding source from Teacup Comet Bank savings, and set up online access with electronic statements for both spouses.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to open a joint taxable account at the existing custodian, initially funded from Teacup Comet Bank savings, with online access and electronic statements for both spouses, due 2024-10-18.

tickets.title: Collect mortgage document packet
